NEW YORK—The Federal Reserve Bank of New York’s Center for Microeconomic Data today released the July 2026Survey of Consumer Expectations, which shows that households’ inflation expectations decreased slightly at the short-term horizon and remained unchanged at the medium- and longer-term horizons. Gas price growth expectations rebounded partially after their sharp decline in June.
